targetRuntime: 6-9 minutes narrator-led pilot; cutdowns available for 45-75 second vertical social episodes
franchiseMandate: Fast-paced Caribbean anime with cliffhangers, built for the full Caribbean and global Black anime audience.
logline: Kai hears a rhythm under Trinidad street life, touches The Listening Bois, and awakens the first Opaija Seed as Marius Vale begins hunting every island's hidden rhythm.
theme: Culture was never background. It was the weapon, the shield, the map, and the memory.
episodePromise: A local Trinidad day turns into a spiritual martial-arts awakening, then opens the map to the wider Caribbean.
cliffhanger: A silent drumbeat answers from another island. Marius says: "The first key woke. Find the rest."

primaryCharacters.name: Kairo "Kai" Baptiste
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Hero; hears the first pulse and awakens The Listening Bois.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Kai model sheet. Medium locs, rounded chin, full lips, broad Caribbean/African nose, lean athletic build, modern Trinidad streetwear, seed pendant, The Listening Bois always readable.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Impulsive rhythm steps, instinctive staff guards, strong heart but incomplete control.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: From hungry, distracted kid chasing doubles to frightened protector making a promise he does not yet understand.

primaryCharacters.name: Mother Lall
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Doubles vendor and hidden Guardian messenger.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Mother Lall sheet. Vendor energy, tray/spoon props, practical clothing, wise eyes, coded paper sigils.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Small efficient Guardian timing; one serving-spoon block should feel shocking and funny.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: She hides truth to protect Kai but knows the first pulse cannot be stopped.

primaryCharacters.name: Nia Toussaint
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Lavway voice specialist; first visible voice-command wave.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Nia sheet. Lavway scarf, rhythm bell, expressive eyes, gold sound ribbons.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Breath, stance, voice ripple, sound ribbon command.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Afraid to be heard, but chooses to shout when fear freezes the street.

primaryCharacters.name: Asha Singh-Baptiste
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Historian/medic; identifies memory marks and next clue.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Asha sheet. Archive props, bandage cords, matador baton, teal/gold notes.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Careful observation, quick bandage-cord movement, precise archive clue handling.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Moves from researching old marks to realizing the marks are still alive.

primaryCharacters.name: Jabari "Jabs" Henry
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Drummer/comic relief/content creator; leaks blurred public proof.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Jabs sheet. Kalinda drum, L-stick beat sticks, creator gear, orange accents.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Fast hand rhythm, camera-phone comedy, panic timing that turns useful.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Turns from joking observer into the counter-beat that keeps everyone moving.

primaryCharacters.name: Malik St. Hill
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Disciplined rival; challenges Kai instead of helping.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Malik sheet. Rootbreaker drum, sticks, wrist wraps, disciplined red/black design.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Clean guards, precise strikes, rhythm-breaking footwork, controlled aggression.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Believes Kai is not worthy of the first pulse.

primaryCharacters.name: Papa Etienne Roach
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Elder batonier and former Guardian; stops the first Kai/Malik clash.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Papa Etienne sheet. Sacred bois hidden cane, elder posture, hidden speed.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Minimal movement, cane tap, ground command, old power under restraint.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: His silence has protected people, but now silence becomes dangerous.

primaryCharacters.name: Marius Vale
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Main villain; appears through silence and confirms Kai is the first key.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Marius sheet. Black bois/silence staff, controlled intimidating posture, no generic armor.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Stillness, sound removal, memory theft pressure, black pulse restraint.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Calm certainty. He believes forced unity is mercy.

primaryCharacters.name: Selah Vale
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Villain heir; rooftop observer uncertain about Kai.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Selah sheet. Silence baton, precision posture, controlled face, purple/black accents.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Rooftop stillness, fast eye movement, poised baton grip.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: Sees Kai as either threat, proof, or future problem.

primaryCharacters.name: Tariq Davidson
primaryCharacters.roleInEpisode: Tobago signal; senses the disturbance from the coast.
primaryCharacters.continuityLock: Use approved Tariq sheet. Tidewatch staff, shell pendant, sea cloth sash, Tobago coastal energy.
primaryCharacters.actionLanguage: Coastal watch stance, tide-sense hand movement, wind and sea response.
primaryCharacters.emotionalArc: The island map expands through him.

sceneBeats.title: Dawn Street Rhythm
sceneBeats.location: Trinidad street with doubles cart, school uniforms, music, old men watching.
sceneBeats.story: The street wakes with life. Kai is late, hungry, and locked onto a doubles cart. Under the ordinary street rhythm, he hears a second rhythm no one else hears.
sceneBeats.camera: Wide establishing crane down into handheld street-level tracking; 35mm lens feel; warm early light.
sceneBeats.action: Kai weaves through people, almost misses a crossing, stops for doubles, then freezes when the hidden rhythm hits.
sceneBeats.fx: Barely visible gold/orange pulse under street sounds; no obvious magic yet.
sceneBeats.narration: In Trinidad, rhythm does not wait for permission. It hides in traffic, steelpan, school shoes, old jokes, and the smell of doubles before sunrise.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: Kai turns toward a sound nobody else heard.

sceneBeats.title: The Wrapper Message
sceneBeats.story: Mother Lall folds a coded paper sigil into Kai's doubles wrapper and warns him to eat before panic starts.
sceneBeats.camera: Medium two-shot, insert close-up on wrapper fold, rack focus from pepper sauce to sigil mark.
sceneBeats.action: Mother Lall's serving spoon taps a rhythm. Kai laughs it off until the wrapper mark briefly glows.
sceneBeats.fx: Tiny cream/gold sigil pulse in the paper fold.
dialogue: Mother Lall: Eat first. Panic after.
Kai: Aunty, why you always talk like something chasing me?
Mother Lall: Because sometimes, child, it already reach.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: The sigil points toward an old wall mark.

sceneBeats.title: Marks That Remember
sceneBeats.location: Old wall, side street, faded paint and hidden Guardian marks.
sceneBeats.story: Asha studies the old marks. She sees memory echo through paint and realizes the symbol on Kai's wrapper is not decorative.
sceneBeats.camera: Macro close-up on cracked paint; slow push into Asha's eye reflection; cut to memory flash frames.
sceneBeats.action: Asha traces the wall but does not touch the glowing center. Bandage cords twitch like they recognize the mark.
sceneBeats.fx: Teal/gold memory shimmer, brief ancestral silhouettes, no literal exposition text.
dialogue: Asha: This mark was painted over.
Kai: So?
Asha: Paint covers walls. Not memory.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: The wall answers with a pulse under Kai's feet.

sceneBeats.title: The First Touch
sceneBeats.location: Hidden storage space behind the wall, half-real gayelle threshold.
sceneBeats.story: Kai finds The Listening Bois. When he touches it, the street begins transforming into a gayelle-like spirit space.
sceneBeats.camera: Low-angle push-in on Kai's hand; close-up on wood grain; 180-degree orbit as the environment changes.
sceneBeats.action: Kai reaches, hesitates, touches the staff, then gets knocked back by a ground pulse. The staff rolls toward him like it chose him.
sceneBeats.fx: Gold/orange rhythm rings, dust lift, wood memory veins, environment split between real Trinidad and old memory.
sceneBeats.narration: A stick has memory. A fighter has spirit. But memory does not wake for everyone.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: The first Opaija Seed opens under Kai.

sceneBeats.title: The Street Becomes Gayelle
sceneBeats.location: Spirit-space gayelle layered over the street.
sceneBeats.story: The street becomes a circle. Jabs' timing breaks, Nia's voice bends the air, and Mother Lall quietly shifts from vendor to Guardian messenger.
sceneBeats.camera: 360-degree circle move, cuts to Jabs phone POV, low-angle on Nia, insert on Mother Lall's spoon grip.
sceneBeats.action: Jabs records a joke, drops timing, then finds a counter-beat. Nia shouts a lavway phrase and a fear wave breaks. Mother Lall blocks a silent strike with her spoon.
sceneBeats.fx: Gold sound ribbons, orange drum sync pulses, cream paper sigils, black silence slash blocked by spoon impact.
dialogue: Jabs: Tell me allyuh seeing this too, right?
Nia: Kai, move!
Mother Lall: I told you eat first.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: A black silence wave cuts all sound.

sceneBeats.title: Marius In The Silence
sceneBeats.location: Same gayelle, now muted by black pulse.
sceneBeats.story: Marius appears without fully revealing his hand. Ambient sound drops away. Selah watches from a rooftop, studying Kai.
sceneBeats.camera: Locked wide with sound drop; slow dolly toward Marius silhouette; cutaway to Selah high-angle rooftop.
sceneBeats.action: Marius lifts the black bois. Sound vanishes. Kai tries to speak but only heartbeat remains. Selah's baton tilts, ready but withheld.
sceneBeats.fx: Black ring absorbs gold pulses; no face-covering effects; silence visualized as pressure distortion.
dialogue: Marius: So the first key woke.
Selah: He looks untrained.
Marius: Good. Fear teaches quickly.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: Marius marks Kai as the first key, not the prize.

sceneBeats.title: Rootbreaker Challenge
sceneBeats.story: Malik enters with Rootbreaker force and challenges Kai instead of helping him. Their clash is short, readable, and interrupted by Papa Etienne.
sceneBeats.camera: Side-on action staging, low-angle guard closeups, lateral tracking during exchange, hard cut on cane strike.
sceneBeats.action: Malik strikes first with controlled rhythm-break. Kai blocks instinctively but overcommits. Malik sweeps. Kai recovers with accidental Tempo Pulse. Papa Etienne stops both with one cane strike to the ground.
sceneBeats.fx: Red-black rhythm break sparks against gold/orange Kai pulse; effects never hide staff contact points.
dialogue: Malik: The stick chose you? That does not mean you earned it.
Kai: I did not ask for this!
Papa Etienne: Then learn before it asks more.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: The Guardian mark opens beneath Papa Etienne's cane.

sceneBeats.title: Not A Gift, A Debt
sceneBeats.story: Papa Etienne reveals the first rule. The seed is not a gift. It is a debt. Asha identifies the route to a forgotten gayelle site.
sceneBeats.camera: Overhead symbol shot, slow push into Papa's face, insert on Asha's notebook and map.
sceneBeats.action: The mark opens in layers. Asha uses bandage cord to stabilize a broken symbol. Kai grips the staff like it may burn him.
sceneBeats.fx: Root pulse, map line glows toward forgotten gayelle site, memory silhouettes behind Papa.
dialogue: Papa Etienne: The stick is not a gift.
Kai: Then what is it?
Papa Etienne: A debt.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: The map line points past the neighborhood, toward an old forgotten circle.

sceneBeats.title: The Rumor Goes Public
sceneBeats.story: Jabs posts a blurred clip before anyone can stop him, starting the public rumor of Opaija.
sceneBeats.camera: Phone-screen insert, fast push into upload button, social comments flicker as abstract shapes without readable generated text.
sceneBeats.action: Jabs tries to delete the clip, but it already spreads. Nia panics. Mother Lall realizes hiding is over.
sceneBeats.fx: Phone glow, rhythm static, no AI-generated readable social text.
dialogue: Jabs: I was saving it in drafts!
Asha: You posted it.
Jabs: Drafts... public drafts?
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: Marius' Echo Thieves detect the leaked pulse.

sceneBeats.title: Another Island Answers
sceneBeats.location: Tobago coast and Marius' Stillwater chamber intercut.
sceneBeats.story: Tariq senses the disturbance from Tobago. Marius gives the Stillwater Order their first command.
sceneBeats.camera: Wide coastal moonlight, close-up shell pendant glow, match cut to black drum circle chamber.
sceneBeats.action: Tariq plants the Tidewatch staff into sand as tide marks glow. Marius stands before the Stillwater Order. Selah lowers her eyes but listens.
sceneBeats.fx: Sea-blue tide pulse answers Kai's gold rhythm; black drum circle absorbs ambient sound.
dialogue: Tariq: That was not thunder.
Marius: The first key woke. Find the rest.
sceneBeats.cliffBeat: A silent drumbeat answers from another island.

verticalCutdowns.title: Kai Hears The First Pulse
verticalCutdowns.hook: Kai only wanted doubles. The rhythm wanted him.
verticalCutdowns.cta: Follow Opaija. Every island has a warrior.

verticalCutdowns.title: Marius Enters In Silence
verticalCutdowns.hook: The villain does not raise his voice. He removes yours.
verticalCutdowns.cta: The False One Drum is coming.

verticalCutdowns.title: Not A Gift, A Debt
verticalCutdowns.hook: The stick chose Kai. That does not mean he earned it.

qcRules: No character design drift from approved model sheets.
No extra fingers, broken staff geometry, random crowds, unreadable weapon contact, or effects hiding faces.
No generated text inside image frames.
Never turn the storyboard into a character bible sheet or grid.
Every action shot must show anticipation, strike/contact, and recovery or reaction.
Use respectful historical language and concrete Caribbean specificity.
